executiveLeadership.name: Tess Allen
executiveLeadership.bio: Promoted to DCVC's first official Executive Director after serving as Board President and Co-President. With an extensive background in the nonprofit sector and conservatory training in dance and music, Tess plays a leading role in guiding DCVC's local advocacy, community programs, and wellness initiatives across Ventura County.

executiveLeadership.name: Genevieve Flores-Haro
executiveLeadership.bio: Guiding public policy, grassroots community advocacy, and intersectional wellness programming across Ventura County.

boardOfDirectors.name: Roland Catabona
boardOfDirectors.bio: Relocated back to his hometown Oxnard after 18+ years in Community and Business Banking. Roland served as co-chair for AIDS Walk Ventura and fundraising chair for Ventura County Pride. Alongside his partner, he has completed multiple AIDS LifeCycle rides and works to grow the region's cyclist and wellness community. He is also a certified Ashtanga Vinyasa yoga instructor.

boardOfDirectors.name: Steve Somann
boardOfDirectors.bio: Co-founder of Diversity Collective in 2014. Served as Treasurer (2014–2015), President (2015–2018), and continues to steward property management and institutional growth for the Community Resource Center.

boardOfDirectors.name: Unique Dowtin
boardOfDirectors.bio: Library professional at The Getty and filmmaker. Unique's work across public library systems fostered her deep dedication to advocacy, lifelong learning, and community building. Since moving to Ventura in 2018, she has volunteered for AIDSWalk, Ventura Pride, and Loud & Queer.

boardOfDirectors.name: Luis Andrade
boardOfDirectors.bio: Testing Specialist with Bank of America Global Risk Management with over two decades of experience in the banking and mortgage sectors. Luis leads events for the Bank of America Southern California LGBT+ Pride Chapter and champions community engagement across Ventura County.

boardOfDirectors.name: Celia Sandhya Daniels
boardOfDirectors.bio: Healthcare management executive, Founder & CEO of Rebekon Consulting, and prominent advocate focusing on biases in AI, healthcare, and gender equity. Recognized as one of the Top 20 LGBTQ leaders in biopharma and Top 10 LGBTQ+ voices on LinkedIn, Celia also serves on the Workforce Development Board of Ventura County and holds leadership positions with PFLAG and Stonewall Democrats.

boardOfDirectors.name: AJ Holmes
boardOfDirectors.bio: Dedicated community organizer, business owner, and photographer based in Ventura County, bringing passionate civic perspective and grassroots support to Diversity Collective's programs and youth outreach.
